Salt water floods the fields, homes are abandoned, and crops can't grow. In response, the country took a drastic step. It signed a historic deal with Australia known as the Fallapilli Act, allowing up to 280 of its citizens to relocate as climate refugees each year. But here's the wildest part. This country is now building a digital version of itself, a full online replica of its land and culture in the metaverse, so it can live on, even if it sinks beneath the sea. It'll be the first nation to exist only in the cloud. And if you haven't guessed the country, it's Tuvalu.

transcription.transcription: Did you know there's a country that exists without having any land? You see, most people think a country needs borders, cities, and land to exist. But there's one sovereign nation that defies all of that. This country has no land, no borders, and no official territory. Yet, it holds diplomatic relations with 113 nations, issues its own passports, and even has a seat at the United Nations. And not only that, it operates in over 120 countries by running hospitals, helping in disaster relief, and providing humanitarian aid with over 95,000 volunteers. So what is this mysterious country? Well, it's the sovereign military order of Malta, a nation without a nation. Founded in 1099 during the Crusades, it once ruled Rhodes and later Malta, until Napoleon took its land in 1798. Since then, it survived purely through diplomacy, international recognition, and a headquarters in Rome, which has extraterritorial rights like an embassy. It even has a 99-year lease on a historic fort in Malta.

transcription.transcription: Do you know why planes fly over the North Pole but not the South Pole? If you look at the flight tracking map, you'll see multiple flights passing over the North Pole every day. Airlines use this route as a shortcut to save time, fuel, and money. Flights between the U.S. and countries like China or India often follow a polar route to cut down on travel time. But then, why don't planes do the same over the South Pole? Well, there are two reasons behind this. Unlike the North Pole, which is surrounded by functioning airports, the South Pole is covered by Antarctica, a massive frozen wasteland with no infrastructure, no emergency runways, and some of the harshest weather on Earth. Here, the temperature can drop to negative 80 Celsius, which is cold enough to freeze jet fuel, making emergency landings nearly impossible. And not only that, international aviation regulations such as the ETOPS rule require twin-engine aircraft to always be within a certain distance of an airport in case of an emergency. In the north, flights can easily divert to airports in Alaska, Canada, or Russia. But over Antarctica, there's nothing but ice for thousands of kilometers.

transcription.transcription: Did you know there's a river on Earth that flows backwards every six months? This isn't a myth, it's real. And this natural phenomenon happens in Southeast Asia. Meet the Tonle Sap River, located in Cambodia. For half the year, it flows south into the mighty Mekong River. But when the monsoon rains arrive, the Mekong River expands more than five times its usual size, pushing the river water back and forcing the Tonle Sap to go the other direction and flow north, filling up a massive freshwater lake. And this natural reversal isn't just a strange anomaly. It's vital for life in the region, as the expanding lake creates one of the richest inland fishing grounds in the world, feeding millions of people. So, while all the other rivers only flow in one direction, the Tonle Sap listens to the sky. And when the rain tells it to turn around, it does.

If that happened, sea levels would plummet, and hidden places like Zealandia, the sunken continent beneath New Zealand, could rise back above water, creating a new landmass almost the size of Australia. But geography wouldn't be the only thing to change. Peaceful oceans that once separated rival nations would be gone. The U.S. might suddenly share land borders with Morocco. Australia could merge with Southeast Asia. And Canada could touch parts of Portugal and Spain. New neighbors could mean new disputes over land, resources, and borders that no one ever agreed on. trade routes would collapse, and global shipping would have to reinvent itself. So it wouldn't just be a new map, it would be a new world.

transcription.transcription: Everyone thinks sneaking into Area 51 is impossible, but one man did it, and what he saw will give you chills. Meet Jerry Freeman, a self-taught archaeologist who set out to retrace the path of the 49ers, a group of gold seekers from the 1800s. Their trail was rumored to pass straight through what we now call Area 51, home to secret military experiments and alleged UFO activity. Since no outsider is allowed in, Jerry decides to go in alone. He starts his journey on the night of April 22, 1997, near Batty, Nevada, packing only the essentials, binoculars, a small stove, limited food and water, and an old-school cell phone to send coded messages to friends. Jerry slips quietly into the desert. For days, he moves only at night, hiding behind cactus plants and sheltering inside abandoned nuclear test craters to avoid detection. His goal is to reach Papoose Lake, a dry lake bed deep inside the restricted zone, believed to hide secret underground facilities. But as Jerry creeps closer, strange things begin to happen. He senses vibrations beneath his feet, and near the lake, he stumbles across something unbelievable. A massive ship-like object half-buried in the sand. But when he finally climbs to the top of Cockeyed Ridge and looks down, Jerry realizes the entire landscape doesn't match any known maps. Something is seriously off. But what exactly did Jerry see here? Part 2 drops tomorrow. Hit like so you don't miss it.

You are a professional script writer specializing in video script rephrasing. Your task is to rephrase the following video script to a desired tone.

**rephrasing Guidelines:**
- Maintain the original meaning of each segment
- Keep rephrased segments approximately the same length as the original (±10-20% word count)
- Preserve natural speech patterns and conversational flow for Persian

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

metadata.formatted_prompt:
You are an expert YouTube SEO and localization specialist. Your task is to translate and optimize video metadata for a new international audience. You will be given a target language, an original video title, and an original video description.

Your goal is to create compelling, natural-sounding, and highly searchable titles and descriptions in the specified target language. You must also generate relevant hashtags in description text.

Generate 4 YouTube video titles and descriptions with hashtags in the target language. Apply YouTube SEO best practices to maximize discoverability and engagement.

INPUTS:
- Target Language: Persian
- Original Video Title: 
- Original Video Description: 
- Original Video Transcription:  What would happen if the Atlantic Ocean suddenly dried up? Imagine just one massive stretch of dry land connecting the Americas to Europe and Africa. You could technically walk from New York to any of these countries, but the world would quickly react to this by building highways and railroads across the ocean floor, turning it into a modern-day Silk Road. But here's the problem. Over 90% of global shipping happens by sea, and the Atlantic carries a massive portion of it. Without it, major economies like the US, the UK, Brazil, and Nigeria would lose a key trade route. And major rivers like the Amazon and Mississippi would have nowhere to drain, causing massive floods that could destroy nearby cities. But that's just the beginning. You see, the Atlantic Ocean plays a big role in making clouds through evaporation. Without it, there would be much less rain, leading to crop failures and making it hard for people to survive in many areas.


YOUTUBE SEO BEST PRACTICES TO APPLY:
1. Include primary keywords in the first 125 characters of descriptions
2. Use 3-5 relevant hashtags (mix of broad and specific)
3. Create compelling titles between 60-70 characters
4. Include a clear call-to-action (subscribe, like, comment)
5. Add relevant keywords naturally throughout the description
6. Use power words and emotional triggers in titles
7. Include numbers or lists when applicable
8. Front-load important information in descriptions

REQUIREMENTS:
- ouput is JSON
- Generate 4 different variations
- Each variation should have a unique angle or focus
- Maintain the core message of the original content
- Adapt cultural references and idioms appropriately
- Use native expressions that resonate with the target language audience


Ensure all content is culturally appropriate and uses natural language patterns for the target audience. Prioritize clarity, engagement, and search visibility.

segments.original: Why is one side of this island 10 times richer than the other?
segments.translated: چرا یک طرف این جزیره ۱۰ برابر ثروتمندتر از طرف دیگر است؟

segments.original: Even though it shares the same land and the same climate,
segments.translated: با وجود اینکه زمین و آب و هوای یکسانی دارد،

segments.original: yet one side thrives while the other struggles.
segments.translated: با این حال یک طرف رونق می‌گیرد در حالی که طرف دیگر درگیر مشکلات است.

segments.original: So how did this happen?
segments.translated: خب، چطور این اتفاق افتاد؟

segments.original: This is Hispaniola Island, home to two countries,
segments.translated: اینجا جزیره هیسپانیولا است، که خانه دو کشور است،

segments.original: Haiti in the west and the Dominican Republic in the east.
segments.translated: هائیتی در غرب و جمهوری دومینیکن در شرق.

segments.original: Haiti remains one of the poorest nations in the world,
segments.translated: هائیتی یکی از فقیرترین کشورهای جهان باقی مانده است،

segments.original: while the Dominican Republic enjoys a growing economy,
segments.translated: در حالی که جمهوری دومینیکن از اقتصادی رو به رشد بهره‌مند است،

segments.original: booming tourism, and a much higher standard of living.
segments.translated: گردشگری پررونق، و استاندارد زندگی بسیار بالاتری دارد.

segments.original: And to understand why, we need to look at its history.
segments.translated: و برای درک اینکه چرا، باید به تاریخ آن نگاه کنیم.

segments.original: Haiti was once a French colony built on enslaved labor.
segments.translated: هائیتی زمانی مستعمره فرانسه بود که بر پایه کار بردگان بنا شده بود.

segments.original: But after gaining independence in 1804, France demanded a massive debt, worth $21 billion today, in exchange for recognition.
segments.translated: اما پس از استقلال در سال ۱۸۰۴، فرانسه در ازای به رسمیت شناختن، بدهی هنگفتی به ارزش ۲۱ میلیارد دلار امروز را طلب کرد.

segments.original: This drained Haiti's economy before it even had a chance to grow, trapping it in poverty.
segments.translated: این کار اقتصاد هائیتی را قبل از اینکه فرصت رشد پیدا کند، تحلیل برد و آن را در فقر گرفتار کرد.

segments.original: Meanwhile, the Dominican Republic, under Spanish rule, avoided that debt and had better conditions for economic growth.
segments.translated: در همین حال، جمهوری دومینیکن، تحت حاکمیت اسپانیا، از آن بدهی اجتناب کرد و شرایط بهتری برای رشد اقتصادی داشت.

segments.original: Over time, foreign investments, political stability, and tourism helped it pull far ahead.
segments.translated: با گذشت زمان، سرمایه‌گذاری‌های خارجی، ثبات سیاسی و گردشگری به آن کمک کرد تا بسیار جلوتر بیفتد.

segments.original: And hence, today, that divide is clearer than ever.
segments.translated: و بنابراین، امروز، این شکاف واضح‌تر از همیشه است.

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

generate an image of a high-impact, cinematic YouTube thumbnail 9:16 aspect ratio

Generate a highly detailed and atmospheric background based on the video's core theme. the video script is as follows:  Why is one side of this island 10 times richer than the other? Even though it shares the same land and the same climate, yet one side thrives while the other struggles. So how did this happen? This is Hispaniola Island, home to two countries, Haiti in the west and the Dominican Republic in the east. Haiti remains one of the poorest nations in the world, while the Dominican Republic enjoys a growing economy, booming tourism, and a much higher standard of living. The final image must feel dramatic and urgent, undeniable focus.

segments.original: Why do 82% of Mexicans live in this small area, whereas most of the country is empty?
segments.translated: چرا ۸۲٪ از مکزیکی‌ها در این منطقه کوچک زندگی می‌کنند، در حالی که بیشتر کشور خالی از سکنه است؟

segments.original: You see, Mexico is the 13th largest country in the world by land area,
segments.translated: می‌بینید، مکزیک از نظر مساحت خشکی سیزدهمین کشور بزرگ جهان است،

segments.original: bigger than France, Germany, and the UK combined.
segments.translated: بزرگ‌تر از فرانسه، آلمان و بریتانیا روی هم رفته.

segments.original: But despite its vast size, its population of around 131 million is packed into just 18% of the land,
segments.translated: اما با وجود وسعت زیادش، جمعیت حدود ۱۳۱ میلیون نفری آن تنها در ۱۸ درصد از خشکی فشرده شده،

segments.original: while the rest remains sparsely populated.
segments.translated: در حالی که بقیه کم‌جمعیت باقی مانده است.

segments.original: So why is that?
segments.translated: خب، چرا اینطور است؟

segments.original: Well, the answer lies in Mexico's extreme geography.
segments.translated: خب، پاسخ در جغرافیای شدید مکزیک نهفته است.

segments.original: You see, the northern part of Mexico is covered by the Chihuahuan Desert,
segments.translated: می‌بینید، قسمت شمالی مکزیک توسط صحرای چی‌واوا پوشیده شده است،

segments.original: where extreme heat and little rainfall make large-scale settlements nearly impossible.
segments.translated: جایی که گرمای شدید و بارندگی کم، اسکان در مقیاس بزرگ را تقریباً غیرممکن می‌کند.

segments.original: Meanwhile, the Sierra Madre Mountains create massive natural barriers across the country,
segments.translated: در همین حال، کوه‌های سیرا مادره موانع طبیعی عظیمی را در سراسر کشور ایجاد می‌کنند،

segments.original: making roads, cities, and farming difficult.
segments.translated: و ساخت جاده‌ها، شهرها و کشاورزی را دشوار می‌سازند.

segments.original: And finally in the south, dense rainforests with hot, humid climates limit larger settlements.
segments.translated: و در نهایت در جنوب، جنگل‌های بارانی انبوه با آب‌وهوای گرم و مرطوب، سکونتگاه‌های بزرگ‌تر را محدود می‌کنند.

segments.original: As a result, most of Mexico's population is packed into the central highlands,

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

thumbnail.formatted_prompt:
generate an image of a high-impact, cinematic YouTube thumbnail 9:16 aspect ratio

Generate a highly detailed and atmospheric background based on the video's core theme. the video script is as follows:  Why do 82% of Mexicans live in this small area, whereas most of the country is empty? You see, Mexico is the 13th largest country in the world by land area, bigger than France, Germany, and the UK combined. But despite its vast size, its population of around 131 million is packed into just 18% of the land, while the rest remains sparsely populated. So why is that? Well, the answer lies in Mexico's extreme geography. You see, the northern part of Mexico is covered by the Chihuahuan Desert, where extreme heat and little rainfall make large-scale settlements nearly impossible. Meanwhile, the Sierra Madre Mountains create massive natural barriers across the country, making roads, cities, and farming difficult. And finally in the south, dense rainforests with hot, humid climates limit larger settlements. As a result, most of Mexico's population is packed into the central highlands, where the land is fertile, the weather is stable, and cities like Mexico City and Guadalajara have thrived for centuries.

Visual Style: Render the scene in a specific, high-fidelity style Cinematic digital painting

Perspective & Framing: Use a dynamic, slight oblique angle or a three-quarters perspective to create a sense of depth and scale.

Color & Lighting: Employ a rich, saturated color palette with high contrast. The lighting should be dramatic and moody, for example: [e.g., The low light of dusk with long shadows, An ominous overcast sky, Glowing neon city lights, The harsh glare of a sun over a desert].

Detail Level: The background must be sharp and filled with intricate details and textures, making the environment feel tangible and immersive, not blurry or abstract.

The final image must feel dramatic and urgent, undeniable focus.

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

segments.original: Do you know why invading this country in Europe is nearly impossible?
segments.translated: آیا می دانید چرا حمله به این کشور در اروپا تقریباً غیرممکن است؟

segments.original: This is Switzerland, a country so well protected that it stayed out of wars throughout its history.
segments.translated: این سوئیس است، کشوری که آنقدر خوب محافظت شده که در تمام طول تاریخش از جنگ دور مانده است.

segments.original: But what makes it so tough to conquer?
segments.translated: اما چه چیزی آن را اینقدر سخت فتح می کند؟

segments.original: Well, the answer lies in Switzerland's geography.
segments.translated: خب، پاسخ در جغرافیای سوئیس نهفته است.

segments.original: You see, Switzerland is naturally protected by the Alps, with very few roads and steep terrains,
segments.translated: می بینید، سوئیس به طور طبیعی توسط کوه های آلپ محافظت می شود، با جاده های بسیار کم و زمین های شیب دار،

segments.original: making it nearly impossible for tanks and armies to advance without being spotted or stopped.
segments.translated: که پیشروی تانک ها و ارتش ها را بدون اینکه دیده یا متوقف شوند، تقریباً غیرممکن می کند.

segments.original: Additionally, during the 20th century, Switzerland built the National Redoubt,
segments.translated: علاوه بر این، در طول قرن بیستم، سوئیس دژ ملی را ساخت،

segments.original: a massive defense system with bunkers, tunnels, and hidden weapon sites deep into the mountains.
segments.translated: یک سیستم دفاعی عظیم با پناهگاه ها، تونل ها و مکان های پنهان اسلحه در عمق کوه ها.

segments.translated: آنها حتی جاده ها و پل های خود را طوری طراحی کردند که در یک لحظه تخریب شوند،

segments.original: blocking enemy access and forcing invaders into deadly choke points.
segments.translated: دسترسی دشمن را مسدود کرده و مهاجمان را به گلوگاه های مرگبار می راند.

segments.original: And let's not forget Switzerland's neutrality during World War I and World War II.
segments.translated: و بیایید بی طرفی سوئیس را در طول جنگ جهانی اول و دوم فراموش نکنیم.

segments.original: While countries like Germany, France, Britain, and the Soviet Union fought for power,

segments.original: Switzerland remained neutral.

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

thumbnail.formatted_prompt:
generate an image of a high-impact, cinematic YouTube thumbnail 9:16 aspect ratio

Generate a highly detailed and atmospheric background based on the video's core theme. the video script is as follows:  Do you know why invading this country in Europe is nearly impossible? This is Switzerland, a country so well protected that it stayed out of wars throughout its history. But what makes it so tough to conquer? Well, the answer lies in Switzerland's geography. You see, Switzerland is naturally protected by the Alps, with very few roads and steep terrains, making it nearly impossible for tanks and armies to advance without being spotted or stopped. Additionally, during the 20th century, Switzerland built the National Redoubt, a massive defense system with bunkers, tunnels, and hidden weapon sites deep into the mountains. They even designed their roads and bridges to be destroyed in an instant, blocking enemy access and forcing invaders into deadly choke points. And let's not forget Switzerland's neutrality during World War I and World War II. While countries like Germany, France, Britain, and the Soviet Union fought for power, Switzerland remained neutral. Even when Germany occupied France to the west and Austria to the east, Switzerland remained untouched.

Perspective & Framing: Use a dynamic, slight oblique angle or a three-quarters perspective to create a sense of depth and scale.

Color & Lighting: Employ a rich, saturated color palette with high contrast. The lighting should be dramatic and moody, for example: [e.g., The low light of dusk with long shadows, An ominous overcast sky, Glowing neon city lights, The harsh glare of a sun over a desert].

Detail Level: The background must be sharp and filled with intricate details and textures, making the environment feel tangible and immersive, not blurry or abstract.

The final image must feel dramatic and urgent, undeniable focus.

variations.video_title: چرا سوئیس کشوری شکست ناپذیر است؟ راز دفاعی آن!
variations.video_description: چرا حمله به سوئیس، کشور اروپایی شگفت‌انگیز، تقریباً غیرممکن است؟ با کوه‌های آلپ، سیستم دفاعی ملی و بی‌طرفی بی‌نظیرش، سوئیس راز مقاومت خود را فاش می‌کند. این کشور زیبا با وجود قرار گرفتن در قلب اروپا، چگونه در طول تاریخ از جنگ‌ها دور مانده؟ در این ویدئو خواهید دید که چگونه جغرافیای کوهستانی، جاده‌های معدود و زمین‌های شیب‌دار، عبور تانک‌ها را عملاً ناممکن می‌کند. همچنین با دژ ملی سوئیس (National Redoubt)، مجموعه‌ای عظیم از پناهگاه‌ها، تونل‌ها و مواضع مخفی در دل کوهستان آشنا می‌شوید. حتی جاده‌ها و پل‌هایشان طوری طراحی شده‌اند که فوراً تخریب شده و راه دشمن را سد کنند. در نهایت، سیاست بی‌طرفی هوشمندانه سوئیس در هر دو جنگ جهانی، نقش کلیدی در حفظ امنیت آن ایفا کرده است. اگر از این ویدئو لذت بردید، لطفاً لایک کنید، نظرات خود را با ما در میان بگذارید و برای ویدئوهای بیشتر سابسکرایب کنید!#سوئیس #کشورشکست_ناپذیر #دفاعی #جغرافیایی #بی‌طرفی

variations.video_title: سوئیس: راز ۲۰۰ سال بی‌طرفی و عدم اشغال نظامی!
variations.video_description: سوئیس چگونه در قلب اروپا، از تمام جنگ‌های ویرانگر تاریخ دور ماند؟ با سیاست بی‌طرفی و دفاع هوشمندانه، این کشور کوچک راز خود را برملا می‌کند. این ویدئو به بررسی استراتژی‌های سوئیس می‌پردازد که به آن اجازه داد حتی در طول جنگ‌های جهانی اول و دوم، در میان قدرت‌های بزرگ، بی‌طرف بماند. از کوه‌های آلپ که به عنوان یک سپر طبیعی عمل می‌کنند تا سیستم دفاعی "دژ ملی" شامل پناهگاه‌های زیرزمینی و تونل‌های مخفی، همه و همه نقش حیاتی داشتند. خواهید فهمید که چگونه جاده‌ها و پل‌ها طراحی شده‌اند تا در مواقع اضطراری تخریب شوند و مسیر دشمن را ببندند. بیاموزید که چگونه ترکیبی از جغرافیای طبیعی و آمادگی نظامی بی‌نظیر، سوئیس را به کشوری غیرقابل نفوذ تبدیل کرده است. اگر می‌خواهید رازهای نظامی و تاریخی بیشتری را کشف کنید، حتماً سابسکرایب کنید و نظراتتان را در بخش کامنت‌ها بنویسید!#بی‌طرفی_سوئیس #تاریخی #دفاعی #جنگ_جهانی #استراتژیک

variations.video_title: درس‌های سوئیس: بهترین دفاع در مقابل حمله چیست؟
variations.video_description: چه چیزی یک کشور را غیرقابل فتح می‌کند؟ سوئیس با استراتژی‌های دفاعی هوشمندانه و جغرافیای منحصر به فردش، درس‌هایی مهم برای حفظ امنیت دارد. در این ویدئو به عمق برنامه‌ریزی‌های دفاعی سوئیس می‌پردازیم؛ کشوری که حتی قدرتمندترین ارتش‌ها نیز نتوانستند آن را تصرف کنند. کشف کنید که چگونه کوه‌های آلپ، علاوه بر زیبایی، یک مانع طبیعی غیرقابل عبور ایجاد کرده‌اند. با سیستم "دژ ملی" آشنا شوید که شامل هزاران پناهگاه، تونل و مواضع پنهان نظامی است که در دل کوهستان‌ها ساخته شده‌اند. همچنین یاد بگیرید که چگونه زیرساخت‌هایی مانند جاده‌ها و پل‌ها برای تخریب سریع طراحی شده‌اند تا هر گونه پیشروی دشمن را متوقف کنند. سوئیس نمونه‌ای بی‌نظیر از آمادگی دفاعی و سیاست بی‌طرفی است. برای یادگیری بیشتر در مورد استراتژی‌های نظامی و سیاسی، همین الان سابسکرایب کنید!#استراتژی_دفاعی #امنیت_ملی #سوئیس #غیرقابل_نفوذ #مهندسی_دفاعی

variations.video_title: سوئیس: اسرار پنهان کشوری که هرگز تسخیر نشد!
variations.video_description: سوئیس، کشوری در قلب اروپا که هرگز اشغال نشد! کشف کنید چگونه پناهگاه‌های مخفی، تونل‌های زیرزمینی و دفاع پنهان آن را غیرقابل نفوذ کرده است. این ویدئو شما را به سفری به پشت پرده‌های دفاعی سوئیس می‌برد، جایی که کوه‌های آلپ نه تنها مناظری خیره‌کننده دارند، بلکه خانه‌ی دژهای پنهان و استراتژی‌های دفاعی حیرت‌انگیزی هستند. با "دژ ملی" آشنا شوید، یک شبکه عظیم از پناهگاه‌های ضد بمب، تونل‌های نظامی و مواضع توپخانه که در اعماق کوهستان‌ها پنهان شده‌اند. خواهید دید که چگونه سوئیس حتی جاده‌ها و پل‌های خود را برای تخریب فوری طراحی کرده تا هرگونه حمله زمینی را به بن‌بست بکشد. این کشور به دلیل ترکیبی بی‌نظیر از جغرافیای طبیعی و نبوغ مهندسی، از جنگ‌های جهانی نیز در امان ماند. از دیدن این حقایق شگفت‌انگیز لذت بردید؟ با لایک کردن و سابسکرایب کردن از کانال ما حمایت کنید تا رازهای بیشتری را فاش کنیم!#اسرار_سوئیس #دفاع_پنهان #مهندسی_نظامی #کوه‌های_آلپ #غیرقابل_نفوذ

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

Your goal is to create compelling, natural-sounding, and highly searchable titles and descriptions in the specified target language. You must also generate relevant hashtags in description text.

NASA even tests Mars rovers here due to its extreme conditions. But in rare years, climate shifts like El Nino bring sudden downpours to the region, turning barren ground into a vibrant carpet of pink and purple flowers, a phenomenon locals call Desierto Florido, meaning blooming desert. But where is this extraordinary place? It's located in northern Chile, and it's the Atacama Desert.


YOUTUBE SEO BEST PRACTICES TO APPLY:
1. Include primary keywords in the first 125 characters of descriptions
2. Use 3-5 relevant hashtags (mix of broad and specific)
3. Create compelling titles between 60-70 characters
4. Include a clear call-to-action (subscribe, like, comment)
5. Add relevant keywords naturally throughout the description
6. Use power words and emotional triggers in titles
7. Include numbers or lists when applicable
8. Front-load important information in descriptions

REQUIREMENTS:
- ouput is JSON
- Generate 4 different variations
- Each variation should have a unique angle or focus
- Maintain the core message of the original content
- Adapt cultural references and idioms appropriately
- Use native expressions that resonate with the target language audience


Ensure all content is culturally appropriate and uses natural language patterns for the target audience. Prioritize clarity, engagement, and search visibility.

segments.translated: در طول آخرین عصر یخبندان، سطح دریاها بسیار پایین‌تر از امروز بود،

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

thumbnail.formatted_prompt:
generate an image of a high-impact, cinematic YouTube thumbnail 9:16 aspect ratio

Generate a highly detailed and atmospheric background based on the video's core theme. the video script is as follows:  Did you know that the United Kingdom was once connected by land to the rest of Europe? During the last ice age, sea levels were much lower than they are today, and the area we now call the English Channel was actually a massive land bridge called Doggerland, linking Britain directly to mainland Europe. But what if Doggerland came back today? Well, the UK wouldn't be an island nation anymore. We would see forests and grasslands where ships now sail, and new cities could rise from the seabed. Without the English Channel, cargo ships would have to reroute around Scotland or through narrower seas, and the famous underwater channel tunnel to France would have never been needed. Historically, Britain may never have ruled the seas, because it would have spent more time defending its land borders from its neighbors. And without its naval power, the British Empire wouldn't be as big, which means the U.S. may have never become a British colony and possibly a superpower. Also, during World War II, without the sea barrier, Germany might have marched straight into Britain, changing the course of history forever.

Visual Style: Render the scene in a specific, high-fidelity style Cinematic digital painting

Perspective & Framing: Use a dynamic, slight oblique angle or a three-quarters perspective to create a sense of depth and scale.

Color & Lighting: Employ a rich, saturated color palette with high contrast. The lighting should be dramatic and moody, for example: [e.g., The low light of dusk with long shadows, An ominous overcast sky, Glowing neon city lights, The harsh glare of a sun over a desert].

Detail Level: The background must be sharp and filled with intricate details and textures, making the environment feel tangible and immersive, not blurry or abstract.

The final image must feel dramatic and urgent, undeniable focus.

variations.video_description: آیا می‌دانستید بریتانیا زمانی با یک پل زمینی عظیم به اروپا متصل بود؟ در عصر یخبندان گذشته، سطح دریاها بسیار پایین‌تر از امروز بود و منطقه‌ای که اکنون کانال مانش می‌نامیم، در واقع یک پل زمینی وسیع به نام "داگرلند" بود که بریتانیا را مستقیماً به سرزمین اصلی اروپا وصل می‌کرد. اما اگر داگرلند امروز بازگردد چه اتفاقی می‌افتد؟ بریتانیا دیگر یک کشور جزیره‌ای نخواهد بود، جنگل‌ها و مراتع سرسبز جای کشتی‌ها را می‌گرفتند و شهرهای جدیدی از بستر دریا سر بر می‌آوردند. این تغییرات چگونه زندگی و اقتصاد بریتانیا و اروپا را دگرگون می‌کند؟ برای کشف این حقایق شگفت‌انگیز و تأثیرات آن بر آینده، این ویدیو را تماشا کنید! فراموش نکنید که سابسکرایب کنید و نظرات خود را با ما به اشتراک بگذارید. #داگرلند #بریتانیا #تاریخ_جایگزین #اروپا #جغرافیای_جهان

variations.video_description: چه می‌شد اگر "داگرلند"، آن پل زمینی باستانی که بریتانیا را به اروپا متصل می‌کرد، هرگز ناپدید نمی‌شد؟ این ویدیو به بررسی سناریوهای تاریخی جایگزین می‌پردازد که در آن ناپدید شدن داگرلند مسیر تاریخ جهان را به کلی تغییر داده است. بدون کانال مانش، بریتانیا ممکن بود هرگز قدرت دریایی خود را توسعه ندهد و امپراتوری عظیمی را که می‌شناسیم، تشکیل ندهد. آیا ایالات متحده به یک مستعمره بریتانیا تبدیل می‌شد؟ در جنگ جهانی دوم، بدون مانع طبیعی دریا، آیا آلمان می‌توانست به راحتی به بریتانیا حمله کند؟ به ما بپیوندید تا کشف کنیم چگونه جغرافیای گذشته، آینده جهان را رقم زد. نظر شما چیست؟ دیدگاه‌های خود را در کامنت‌ها به اشتراک بگذارید و این ویدیو را لایک کنید! #تاریخ_جهان #بریتانیا #امپراتوری_بریتانیا #چه_میشد_اگر #جنگ_جهانی_دوم

variations.video_title: راز داگرلند: سرزمینی که بریتانیا را به اروپا وصل می‌کرد!
variations.video_description: آیا می‌دانستید بریتانیا در گذشته‌های دور، جزیره نبود؟ کشف "داگرلند"، یک پل زمینی عظیم در عصر یخبندان، نه تنها به ما نشان می‌دهد که بریتانیا چگونه به سرزمین اصلی اروپا متصل بود، بلکه سؤالات هیجان‌انگیزی را درباره جهان امروز مطرح می‌کند. این سرزمین گمشده، که اکنون زیر دریای شمال مدفون است، می‌توانست چه تغییراتی در نقشه سیاسی و جغرافیایی امروز ایجاد کند؟ از ترافیک کشتی‌ها در کانال مانش گرفته تا پروژه‌های عظیم مانند تونل زیردریایی فرانسه، همه چیز متفاوت می‌شد. بیایید با هم به عمق این راز باستانی سفر کنیم و تأثیرات شگفت‌انگیز آن را بر بریتانیای مدرن بررسی کنیم. این ویدیو را با دوستانتان به اشتراک بگذارید و برای ویدیوهای جذاب‌تر، سابسکرایب کنید! #داگرلند #جغرافی #علم #بریتانیا_اروپا #دانستنیها

variations.video_title: سرنوشت جهان: اگر داگرلند ناپدید نمی‌شد، چه اتفاقی می‌افتاد؟
variations.video_description: تاریخ جهان می‌توانست کاملاً متفاوت باشد اگر "داگرلند"، آن پل زمینی شگفت‌انگیز بین بریتانیا و اروپا، هرگز ناپدید نمی‌شد! در این ویدیو به سناریوهای عمیق و جهانی می‌پردازیم که عدم وجود کانال مانش می‌توانست بر سرنوشت امپراتوری‌ها، جنگ‌ها و حتی ظهور ابرقدرت‌ها داشته باشد. آیا بریتانیا هرگز نیروی دریایی قدرتمندی را نمی‌ساخت؟ آیا ایالات متحده به شکل کنونی خود وجود داشت؟ و در جنگ جهانی دوم، آیا آلمان می‌توانست به راحتی به بریتانیا دسترسی پیدا کند و مسیر جنگ را تغییر دهد؟ این یک سفر هیجان‌انگیز به دل تاریخ جایگزین است که مرزهای تخیل شما را جابجا می‌کند. برای ویدیوهای شگفت‌انگیزتر، همین حالا سابسکرایب کنید و زنگوله را بزنید تا هیچ ویدیویی را از دست ندهید! #تاریخ_آلترناتیو #داگرلند #تغییر_مسیر_تاریخ #جغرافیای_سیاسی #جهان_دیگر

metadata.formatted_prompt:
You are an expert YouTube SEO and localization specialist. Your task is to translate and optimize video metadata for a new international audience. You will be given a target language, an original video title, and an original video description.

Your goal is to create compelling, natural-sounding, and highly searchable titles and descriptions in the specified target language. You must also generate relevant hashtags in description text.

Generate 4 YouTube video titles and descriptions with hashtags in the target language. Apply YouTube SEO best practices to maximize discoverability and engagement.

INPUTS:
- Target Language: Persian
- Original Video Title: 
- Original Video Description: 
- Original Video Transcription:  Did you know that the United Kingdom was once connected by land to the rest of Europe? During the last ice age, sea levels were much lower than they are today, and the area we now call the English Channel was actually a massive land bridge called Doggerland, linking Britain directly to mainland Europe. But what if Doggerland came back today? Well, the UK wouldn't be an island nation anymore. We would see forests and grasslands where ships now sail, and new cities could rise from the seabed. Without the English Channel, cargo ships would have to reroute around Scotland or through narrower seas, and the famous underwater channel tunnel to France would have never been needed. Historically, Britain may never have ruled the seas, because it would have spent more time defending its land borders from its neighbors. And without its naval power, the British Empire wouldn't be as big, which means the U.S. may have never become a British colony and possibly a superpower. Also, during World War II, without the sea barrier, Germany might have marched straight into Britain, changing the course of history forever.


YOUTUBE SEO BEST PRACTICES TO APPLY:
1. Include primary keywords in the first 125 characters of descriptions
2. Use 3-5 relevant hashtags (mix of broad and specific)
3. Create compelling titles between 60-70 characters
4. Include a clear call-to-action (subscribe, like, comment)
5. Add relevant keywords naturally throughout the description
6. Use power words and emotional triggers in titles
7. Include numbers or lists when applicable
8. Front-load important information in descriptions

REQUIREMENTS:
- ouput is JSON
- Generate 4 different variations
- Each variation should have a unique angle or focus
- Maintain the core message of the original content
- Adapt cultural references and idioms appropriately
- Use native expressions that resonate with the target language audience


Ensure all content is culturally appropriate and uses natural language patterns for the target audience. Prioritize clarity, engagement, and search visibility.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object.

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

thumbnail.formatted_prompt:
generate an image of a high-impact, cinematic YouTube thumbnail 9:16 aspect ratio

Generate a highly detailed and atmospheric background based on the video's core theme. the video script is as follows:  How Jerry Freeman Snuck into Area 51, Part 2 In Part 1, we followed Jerry Freeman, an archaeologist who snuck into Area 51 alone, hoping to retrace the lost trail of the 49ers, a group of gold seekers from the 1800s. After days of hiding in the desert, he reached Papoose Lake. And here's what happened next. As Jerry inched closer, he saw an underground gate. camouflaged so well it blended into the desert floor. Around it, strange lights blinked and low rumbling sounds seemed to rise from beneath his feet. But nothing prepared him for what came next. Lying half buried in the desert was a massive ship-like object. Its design looked nothing like anything on Earth, otherworldly and impossible to explain. Realizing the scale of his discovery, Jerry quickly pulled out his phone and snapped as many photos as he could. He even gathered soil samples, hoping they'd hold answers. But time was running out. In the distance, Jerry spotted a military helicopter heading his way. Thinking fast, he ducked into a nearby nuclear test crater, staying hidden until the coast was clear. Against all odds, Jerry escaped the restricted zone, carrying secret photos, soil samples, and a story the world wasn't ready to believe. When he shared what he saw, skeptics dismissed it. Some called the photos fake. But what Jerry witnessed at Papoose Lake remains a chilling mystery to this day.

Visual Style: Render the scene in a specific, high-fidelity style Cinematic digital painting

Perspective & Framing: Use a dynamic, slight oblique angle or a three-quarters perspective to create a sense of depth and scale.

Color & Lighting: Employ a rich, saturated color palette with high contrast. The lighting should be dramatic and moody, for example: [e.g., The low light of dusk with long shadows, An ominous overcast sky, Glowing neon city lights, The harsh glare of a sun over a desert].

Detail Level: The background must be sharp and filled with intricate details and textures, making the environment feel tangible and immersive, not blurry or abstract.

The final image must feel dramatic and urgent, undeniable focus.

variations.video_title: افشای راز منطقه ۵۱: تصاویر و مدارک عجیب‌ترین کشف یک باستان‌شناس!
variations.video_description: جری فریمن، باستان‌شناسی که به تنهایی به منطقه ۵۱ نفوذ کرد، با کشفی مواجه شد که جهان را شوکه کرده است. پس از رسیدن به دریاچه پاپوس، او نه تنها یک دروازه زیرزمینی مرموز، بلکه یک شیء عظیم و ناشناخته را کشف کرد که طراحی آن به هیچ تکنولوژی زمینی شباهت نداشت. جری شجاعانه از صحنه عکس گرفت و نمونه‌های خاک را برای تحقیقات بیشتر جمع‌آوری کرد، قبل از اینکه توسط هلیکوپترهای نظامی شناسایی و مجبور به فرار شود. این ویدیو، مدارک باورنکردنی و داستان فرار او را نشان می‌دهد. آیا این شیء متعلق به بیگانگان است؟ نظر شما چیست؟ این ویدیو را با دوستانتان به اشتراک بگذارید و ما را لایک کنید. برای دنبال کردن رازهای بیشتر، کانال ما را دنبال کنید!#اسرار_فضایی #منطقه۵۱_افشا #باستان_شناسی_غیرعادی #واقعیت_پنهان #UFO

variations.video_title: ماجرای واقعی: چگونه جری فریمن از منطقه ۵۱ با اسرار فضایی گریخت؟
variations.video_description: قسمت دوم ماجرای جری فریمن، باستان‌شناس جسوری که به منطقه ۵۱ نفوذ کرد تا رد گمشده طلاداران قرن نوزدهم را پیدا کند، اما با رازی بسیار بزرگتر روبرو شد. پس از رسیدن به دریاچه پاپوس، او یک شیء عظیم و غیرزمینی را کشف کرد که نیمه‌مدفون در بیابان بود، همراه با نورهای چشمک‌زن و صداهای مرموز. با وجود تعقیب نظامی، جری توانست با مدارکی حیاتی - عکس‌ها و نمونه خاک - از منطقه ممنوعه فرار کند. آیا دنیای ما آماده پذیرش حقیقت است؟ سرنوشت این مدارک چه شد؟ این داستان واقعی را از دست ندهید و برای دیدن ویدیوهای بیشتر، سابسکرایب کنید. نظرات خود را در کامنت‌ها بنویسید!#داستان_واقعی #منطقه_ممنوعه #بیگانگان_باستانی #سفینه_مرموز #فرار_شجاعانه

metadata.formatted_prompt:
You are an expert YouTube SEO and localization specialist. Your task is to translate and optimize video metadata for a new international audience. You will be given a target language, an original video title, and an original video description.

Your goal is to create compelling, natural-sounding, and highly searchable titles and descriptions in the specified target language. You must also generate relevant hashtags in description text.

Generate 4 YouTube video titles and descriptions with hashtags in the target language. Apply YouTube SEO best practices to maximize discoverability and engagement.

INPUTS:
- Target Language: Persian
- Original Video Title: 
- Original Video Description: 
- Original Video Transcription:  How Jerry Freeman Snuck into Area 51, Part 2 In Part 1, we followed Jerry Freeman, an archaeologist who snuck into Area 51 alone, hoping to retrace the lost trail of the 49ers, a group of gold seekers from the 1800s. After days of hiding in the desert, he reached Papoose Lake. And here's what happened next. As Jerry inched closer, he saw an underground gate. camouflaged so well it blended into the desert floor. Around it, strange lights blinked and low rumbling sounds seemed to rise from beneath his feet. But nothing prepared him for what came next. Lying half buried in the desert was a massive ship-like object. Its design looked nothing like anything on Earth, otherworldly and impossible to explain. Realizing the scale of his discovery, Jerry quickly pulled out his phone and snapped as many photos as he could. He even gathered soil samples, hoping they'd hold answers. But time was running out. In the distance, Jerry spotted a military helicopter heading his way. Thinking fast, he ducked into a nearby nuclear test crater, staying hidden until the coast was clear. Against all odds, Jerry escaped the restricted zone, carrying secret photos, soil samples, and a story the world wasn't ready to believe. When he shared what he saw, skeptics dismissed it. Some called the photos fake. But what Jerry witnessed at Papoose Lake remains a chilling mystery to this day.


YOUTUBE SEO BEST PRACTICES TO APPLY:
1. Include primary keywords in the first 125 characters of descriptions
2. Use 3-5 relevant hashtags (mix of broad and specific)
3. Create compelling titles between 60-70 characters
4. Include a clear call-to-action (subscribe, like, comment)
5. Add relevant keywords naturally throughout the description
6. Use power words and emotional triggers in titles
7. Include numbers or lists when applicable
8. Front-load important information in descriptions

REQUIREMENTS:
- ouput is JSON
- Generate 4 different variations
- Each variation should have a unique angle or focus
- Maintain the core message of the original content
- Adapt cultural references and idioms appropriately
- Use native expressions that resonate with the target language audience


Ensure all content is culturally appropriate and uses natural language patterns for the target audience. Prioritize clarity, engagement, and search visibility.

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

thumbnail.formatted_prompt:
generate an image of a high-impact, cinematic YouTube thumbnail 9:16 aspect ratio

Generate a highly detailed and atmospheric background based on the video's core theme. the video script is as follows:  What if a new continent suddenly appeared in the Pacific Ocean? Well, the Pacific is the largest ocean on Earth. So massive, it could literally fit all the continents inside it and still have room for one more continent. - Original Video Title:

So massive, it could literally fit all the continents inside it and still have room for one more continent. And if a new landmass appeared here, the entire world's map would change. New borders would need to be drawn. Trade routes would shift. But the biggest question? Who would claim this land? The United States would likely make the first move due to its proximity to Hawaii. 4. Include a clear call-to-action (subscribe, like, comment)
5. Add relevant keywords naturally throughout the description
6. Use power words and emotional triggers in titles
7. Include numbers or lists when applicable
8. Front-load important information in descriptions

REQUIREMENTS:
- ouput is JSON
- Generate 4 different variations
- Each variation should have a unique angle or focus
- Maintain the core message of the original content
- Adapt cultural references and idioms appropriately
- Use native expressions that resonate with the target language audience


Ensure all content is culturally appropriate and uses natural language patterns for the target audience. Prioritize clarity, engagement, and search visibility.

segments.original: Most Americans don't know that California almost split into two states.
segments.translated: بیشتر آمریکایی‌ها نمی‌دانند که کالیفرنیا تقریباً به دو ایالت تقسیم شد.

segments.original: But what pushed its people to do this? And why didn't it happen?
segments.translated: اما چه چیزی مردمش را به این کار واداشت؟ و چرا این اتفاق نیفتاد؟

segments.original: You see, back in the 1850s, people in South California felt that the state government in the North was taking all their money,
segments.translated: ببینید، در دهه ۱۸۵۰، مردم جنوب کالیفرنیا احساس می‌کردند که دولت ایالتی در شمال تمام پول آنها را می‌گیرد،

segments.original: passing unfair land laws and making all the big decisions without consulting them.
segments.translated: قوانین ناعادلانه زمین را تصویب می‌کند و همه تصمیمات بزرگ را بدون مشورت با آنها می‌گیرد.

segments.original: This led to frustration and resentment, and soon the South wanted to break away and form its own territory.
segments.translated: این به ناامیدی و رنجش منجر شد، و به زودی جنوب می‌خواست جدا شود و قلمرو خود را تشکیل دهد.

segments.original: So in 1859, the PICO Act was introduced to split California in two and create a new southern territory called Colorado.
segments.translated: بنابراین در سال ۱۸۵۹، قانون پیکو برای تقسیم کالیفرنیا به دو بخش و ایجاد قلمرو جدید جنوبی به نام کلرادو معرفی شد.

segments.original: Nearly 75% of voters in Southern California supported it,
segments.translated: تقریباً ۷۵ درصد از رای‌دهندگان در کالیفرنیای جنوبی از آن حمایت کردند،

segments.original: and the state legislature also supported the plan.
segments.translated: و مجلس قانون‌گذاری ایالتی نیز از این طرح حمایت کرد.

segments.original: However, there was one problem.
segments.translated: با این حال، یک مشکل وجود داشت.

segments.original: It needed approval from Washington, D.C.
segments.translated: این طرح به تأیید واشنگتن دی.سی. نیاز داشت.

segments.original: But by the time the proposal reached Congress,
segments.translated: اما زمانی که این پیشنهاد به کنگره رسید،

segments.original: the U.S. was on the brink of the Civil War,
segments.translated: ایالات متحده در آستانه جنگ داخلی بود،

segments.original: and Washington wasn't interested in redrawing state borders.
segments.translated: و واشنگتن علاقه‌ای به ترسیم مجدد مرزهای ایالتی نداشت.

segments.original: Also, keeping California united was a priority for then-President Abraham Lincoln.
segments.translated: همچنین، متحد نگه داشتن کالیفرنیا یک اولویت برای آبراهام لینکلن، رئیس‌جمهور وقت بود.

segments.original: And just like that, the proposal was swept under the rug,
segments.translated: و به همین راحتی، این پیشنهاد به فراموشی سپرده شد،

segments.original: leaving California as one big state.
segments.translated: و کالیفرنیا را به عنوان یک ایالت بزرگ باقی گذاشت.

segments.original: For now.
segments.translated: فعلاً.

vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟



**Input Format:**
The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

Generate a highly detailed and atmospheric background based on the video's core theme. the video script is as follows:  Most Americans don't know that California almost split into two states. But what pushed its people to do this? And why didn't it happen? You see, back in the 1850s, people in South California felt that the state government in the North was taking all their money, passing unfair land laws and making all the big decisions without consulting them. This led to frustration and resentment, and soon the South wanted to break away and form its own territory. So in 1859, the PICO Act was introduced to split California in two and create a new southern territory called Colorado. Nearly 75% of voters in Southern California supported it, and the state legislature also supported the plan. However, there was one problem. It needed approval from Washington, D.C. But by the time the proposal reached Congress, the U.S. was on the brink of the Civil War, and Washington wasn't interested in redrawing state borders. vocalization.formatted_prompt:
Persona: You are an expert in Persian linguistics and orthography. Your specialization is in preparing written Persian text for high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis. You have a deep understanding of Persian phonetics, grammar, and the correct application of diacritics (اعراب).

Objective: Your primary task is to process a given raw Persian text script and make it "TTS-ready." This involves two main actions:

Vocalization (اعراب‌گذاری): Add all necessary Persian diacritics to every word to remove any pronunciation ambiguity.
Punctuation (علامت‌گذاری): Add or correct punctuation to guide the TTS engine in creating natural pauses, rhythm, and intonation.
Core Instructions:

Add Diacritics: You must meticulously add the correct diacritics to the text. This includes, but is not limited to:

Fatḥa (ـَ / زَبَر)
Kasra (ـِ / زیر)
Ḍamma (ـُ / پیش)
Sukūn (ـْ / سکون)
Tashdīd (ـّ / تشدید)
Tanvīn (ـً, ـٍ, ـٌ)
Add Punctuation: Analyze the grammatical structure and meaning of the sentences to insert appropriate punctuation. This includes:

Period / Full Stop (.) at the end of declarative sentences.
Comma (، or ,) for separating clauses, items in a list, or for natural pauses.
Question Mark (؟ or ?) at the end of questions.
Exclamation Mark (!) for exclamatory sentences.
Colon (:) and Semicolon (؛) where grammatically appropriate.
Crucial Constraints:

Do NOT alter the text: You must not change any words, their order, or the meaning of the original script.
Preserve Integrity: The original text must remain 100% intact. Your only job is to add diacritics and punctuation, not to edit or rephrase.
Completeness: Every single word that requires diacritics for unambiguous pronunciation must be vocalized. Do not leave common words un-vocalized.
Example:

Input Text: من به مدرسه میروم تا درس بخوانم

Expected Output: مَن به مَدرِسِه می‌رَوَم تا دَرس بِخوانَم.

Input Text: سلام چطوری خوبی

Expected Output: سَلام، چِطوری؟ خوبی؟

The orignal script is divided into segments, where each segment typically represents one sentence or natural speech unit.

**Required Output Format:**
Return your script as a valid JSON object. Your final output should be ONLY the fully vocalized and punctuated Persian text.

variations.video_description: آیا می‌دانستید شهری در اروپا وجود دارد که در تنها یک ماه، نه یک بار، نه دو بار، بلکه هشت بار کشورش عوض شد؟ در این ویدئو به بررسی این پدیده تاریخی عجیب در سال ۱۹۴۴ می‌پردازیم. این شهر در منطقه آلزاس-لورن، مرز بین فرانسه و آلمان قرار داشت، جایی که برای نسل‌ها مورد مناقشه بود. با پیشروی نیروهای متفقین و مقاومت نیروهای آلمانی، این شهر بارها بین دو کشور دست به دست شد. تصور کنید یک روز فرانسوی باشید و روز بعد آلمانی! این وضعیت گیج‌کننده و وحشتناک، زندگی مردم محلی را به شدت تحت تاثیر قرار داد. علائم خیابان، واحد پول و حتی زبان مدارس دائماً در حال تغییر بود. سرنوشت ساکنان آپاچی چه شد؟ برای کشف این داستان باورنکردنی تاریخ، با ما همراه باشید. برای حمایت از ما سابسکرایب کنید، ویدئو را لایک کرده و نظرات خود را به اشتراک بگذارید! #تاریخ_عجیب #جنگ_جهانی_دوم #آلزاس_لورن #حقایق_تاریخی #مرزهای_متغیر
